I was forced to sign the decree of divorce by my mother after serious differences developed between my family and my wife's family over whether my wife, who is a doctor, should work or not. My wife's family on the other hand were adamant that she will work no matter what. She had already spent about five months at her parent's house before my daughter's birth due to differences on permission to work and having a separate house. She came back to my house after our child's birth. After my wife left again, my mother pressurised me to divorce her but I kept avoiding it expecting my wife and her parents to relent on their demand. Question: assalamualaikum at first time i with the intention of rajaee said a talla and not pronounced complete words just tallaa and stopped and feared said my wife to go her home and i will get referred about this matter after a weak i found that if any one said one tallaq with the niyyat of rajaee the nikah never collapses then i forgot about that but after some days gone when she planned to escape and put me in trouble i used to say that MY TUJHE EK TALLAQ DERAHA HU at that time the first situation in which i not completed total words of tallaq is not in my knowledge.i get connected with moulana and he said if a person says two tallaqs with the niyyat of rajaeee nikah never collapsed. after rajaee i said her if you go home with out permission the other two tallaq will occur TUM GHAR CHALE GAYE AB THO AUR DO TALLAQ. in this situation i only warned her and not used two times the words. she then requested me and i took her to her home. now she saying that two tallaqs occured and to forget her i used to myself that imagine that she had given three tallaqs. if i myself says is tallaq occurs please guide me in rightious way. Answer ID: 29219 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 270/D=20/k=1432) Talaq takes place even if the words of talaq are uttered for threatening though there is no intention of talaq. But if the talaq was conditional, then it shall take place when the condition will be fulfilled, not before it. Thus in the question mentioned above, if you have said these words: "If you go home without permission the other two talaqs will occur", if the wife went home without permission, then the two talaqs shall take place, otherwise not. If she did not go herself rather you took her, then too no talaq will occur. However, one talaq raja'i (revocable) took place in the case when you said before this event "I am giving you one talaq". And no talaq will take place if you said 'talla' without saying complete word of talaq and which was not heard by anyone. In short, the ruling of only one talaq shall be applied by the sentence "I am giving you one talaq". In this case, the husband has the right to take her back within the iddah period and they will have to do a fresh nikah once the iddah is over. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
